title: Execution control plane
goal: Preserve the approved WIP checkpoint and install the bounded, single-authority Admin execution system.
exitCriteria: Every finding, specification task, and workflow completion has exactly one primary batch.
The generated ADM-B00 context pack is at most 32 KiB and all generated views have zero drift.

title: Reproducible baseline and migration chain
goal: Restore fresh creation, legacy upgrade, type-check, build, tests, route, service-role, and migration gates without unexplained failures.
exitCriteria: A fresh isolated database and representative legacy upgrade complete with reconciliation evidence.
The complete baseline command is repeatable and has no unexplained failures.

title: Identity, tenant isolation, and privileged execution
goal: Complete trusted acting context, memberships, capabilities, revocation, RLS, actor-bound RPCs, service jobs, storage policy, and audit enforcement.
exitCriteria: Org A, Org B, revoked, stale, unauthenticated, and technical-principal tests pass through API and direct data access.
No critical elevation, actor-binding, or tenant-isolation finding remains open.

title: SEC-104 site-map zone recovery
goal: Finish the checkpointed site-map zone bridge after its migration and authorization prerequisites are verified.
exitCriteria: Site-map zone collection and item commands enforce acting organization, capability, ownership, idempotency, and audit behavior.
Fresh migration, reconciliation, direct RLS bypass, retry, and recovery evidence passes.

title: Canonical events and ingestion
goal: Make events_v2 canonical across provider ingestion, reconciliation, event lifecycle, provisioning, and publication.
exitCriteria: Legacy event writes are retired and ID reconciliation reports zero unexplained discrepancies.
Provider ingestion through Admin publication passes with retry, rollback, and audit evidence.

title: Tours and Artist delivery
goal: Complete event-to-tour planning, publication, roster convergence, and Artist-visible itinerary delivery.
exitCriteria: Provider event to published tour to Artist-visible itinerary succeeds with canonical IDs and local-time correctness.
Autosave, duplicate, quarantine, holds, ghost-stop, idempotency, and recovery cases pass.

title: Hiring and onboarding
goal: Complete requisition, application, invitation, offer, onboarding, and worker provisioning with server-controlled lifecycle states.
exitCriteria: Candidate invitation delivery, redemption, expiration, replay prevention, failure visibility, and organization scoping pass.
Accepted candidates provision exactly one worker identity and can continue to workforce assignment.

title: Workforce roster and check-in
goal: Complete assignment, roster, schedule publication, acknowledgement, conflict handling, replacement, notification, and check-in.
exitCriteria: Admin-to-worker assignment, notification, acknowledgement, roster, replacement, and check-in journeys pass.
Cross-organization, forged status, revoked user, duplicate, partial failure, and retry cases fail safely.

title: Messaging, private storage, and delivery workers
goal: Complete conversations, unread and reply state, private attachments, broadcasts, reminders, outboxes, retry, dead letters, and delivery receipts.
exitCriteria: Private files reject public URLs and signed links expire or revoke as configured.
All scheduled workers expose idempotent retry, dead-letter, monitoring, and recipient delivery evidence.

title: Operational logistics delivery
goal: Complete logistics, travel, lodging, catering, transport, equipment, advancing, and live operations with recipient acknowledgement.
exitCriteria: All operational records reference canonical event, stop, leg, organization, and recipient identities.
Producer, recipient acknowledgement, isolation, DST, partial failure, retry, and reversal journeys pass.

title: Organization, Artist, and Venue administration
goal: Scope organization settings and Artist/Venue administration to authorized organizations and remove global discovery and unsafe writes.
exitCriteria: Search, CRUD, import, metrics, relationships, and deletion are tenant-scoped and server-authorized.
Org B, forged identifier, revoked user, direct API, and unsafe-delete tests pass.

title: Ticketing and admissions
goal: Complete ticketing setup, inventory, holds, guest lists, credentials, devices, webhooks, admissions, reconciliation, and delivery.
exitCriteria: Ticketing producer-to-recipient and admissions journeys pass using canonical event identities.
Inventory, credential, device, webhook, offline, duplicate, isolation, and reconciliation cases pass.

title: Constrained commercial and provider administration
goal: Enforce finance read-only, contracts tracking-only, vendor delivery, and platform-internal provider administration.
exitCriteria: Organization Admin finance writes, contract signing/executed claims, and provider tools are hidden and server-denied.
Allowed read, tracking, notification, export, isolation, and internal-platform journeys pass.

title: Navigation, accessibility, responsiveness, and reliability
goal: Finish canonical routes, URL state, accessible responsive UI, bounded data access, performance budgets, recovery states, and observability.
exitCriteria: Critical journeys pass at phone, tablet, and desktop sizes using keyboard and screen-reader-oriented checks.
Navigation, query, performance, monitoring, retry, offline, and error-recovery budgets pass.

title: Independent verification and release
goal: Reproduce all launch evidence in a clean context, complete human sign-offs, and pilot a restricted organization cohort.
exitCriteria: All required launch gates are evidence-complete on one immutable staging commit and a freshly migrated database.
Independent technical verification, product approval, security approval, and restricted pilot evidence are recorded with zero registry drift.
